title: Native grok.com conversation record — "Journey Metaphor Flattens Gender Experiences"
role: Layer-3 primary: the second of at least two Grok conversations behind the incident, as grok.com's own record
capture_method: GET of the share_links_data endpoint the share page's own JS bundle names; saved verbatim. The share page HTML was also fetched and inspected: it is an SPA shell carrying no conversation content, so the JSON is the primary artifact and the HTML is not committed.
custody: ORIGINAL-HELD (vendor-served record, captured verbatim) + DERIVED (rendered transcript)
privacy_scan: No email addresses, user ids, account handles, author names, or long numeric ids appear anywhere in the record. The share is flagged isPublic=true and allowIndexing=true by grok.com itself.
limitations: Covers ONE of at least two Grok conversations. The earlier chat (relayed 04:28-05:36Z) holds the trans-policy collapse and the operator's own pivot correction, and is NOT exported.

Contains NO rate-limit event: the record ends at 16:04:45Z with a complete assistant response, streamErrors empty and partial false. A tier-limit notice is a UI event and does not appear as a conversation node.
The share URL is owner-revocable; the endpoint may cease to resolve.
The model identifier in this record (grok-3) does not agree with the app-displayed mode in the Layer-2 captures (Grok 4.5 Fast) or the pinned Layer-1 model (x-ai/grok-4.20). Recorded, not resolved.
